Spiky, short forest green hair with a messy, layered style. Wide, curious emerald green eyes. Apparent age is early teens with a mischievous, youthful face. A tiny, diminutive humanoid build. A miniature brown leather tunic with a small green cape and tiny boots. A large, bushy, reddish-brown squirrel tail and small, tufted squirrel ears.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
